name: toggle
summary: A single pressable button that stays pressed until pressed again, styled like one segment of a toggle group.
useWhen: One on/off formatting option sits in a toolbar, such as showing the grid overlay on a canvas.

alternatives.name: switch
alternatives.when: the setting is labeled text in a list or form

rules.do: Give an icon-only toggle an `aria-label`, such as "Show grid".
rules.dont: Ship an icon toggle that a screen reader announces only as "toggle button".

a11y: Announces pressed or not pressed; Space and Enter toggle it.
